japan.basis: lyricist 土井晩翠 Doi Bansui (1952); composer 瀧廉太郎 Taki Rentaro (1903). The later of the two deaths is 1952.
japan.test: Japan: both authors died 1967 or earlier, or the work is anonymous and published 1967 or earlier.

us.test: US: published 1930 or earlier, or published later with every author dead in 1945 or earlier, because the URAA restored anything still protected in its source country on 1996-01-01.

_licence.confidence_text: High. Yamada's 1917 arrangement is also clear (d. 1965, pub. 1917).

items.line: はる こうろうの はなの えん

gloss.en: Spring, a blossom banquet in the high tower; moonlight fell across the cups as they passed, breaking through thousand-year pine boughs. Where is that old light now?
gloss.es: Primavera, un banquete de flores en la torre alta; la luz de la luna caía sobre las copas que pasaban de mano en mano, filtrándose entre pinos de mil años. ¿Dónde está ahora aquella luz antigua?
